# Würzburg Moments — Travel inspiration and portrait experiences

> Würzburg Moments is an independent travel-inspiration website for visitors from China, Japan and other countries. It introduces Würzburg sights and portrait experiences by Phil Splash (Philipp Mulfinger), a local artist in Würzburg, Bavaria, Germany. It is not the official tourist information service. His mission is to portray one million people. His project started in Munich’s underground in 2010.

## Services
- Live portrait sessions for tour groups from 10 people in Würzburg and Mainfranken; other Bavarian locations on request. Advance booking, suitable location and individual quote required. No scheduled street presence or public walk-in studio.
- Portraits commissioned from photos: EUR 30 per portrait. Larger orders: ask for a group quote. Format, special backgrounds, deadline and handover agreed before ordering. A Marienberg Fortress background may be requested; the image on the page is a layout concept.
- Enquiries are non-binding. No instant availability, guaranteed same-day service or automatic contract.
